title: A Time for Everything?
question: If God sets a season for every purpose, how should we live within His timing rather than our own?
blurb: Every season under heaven has its hour. Trace how Scripture frames God's timing and how we are to meet it.

nodes.content: If God sets a season for every purpose, how should we live within His timing rather than our own?

nodes.verseText: To everything there is a season, and a time for every purpose under heaven:
He has made everything beautiful in its time. He has also set eternity in the hearts of men, yet they cannot fathom the work that God has done from beginning to end.
a time to be born and a time to die, a time to plant and a time to uproot,
My times are in Your hands; deliver me from my enemies and from those who pursue me.
